instruction: Does being near a special day appear associated with conversion in this dataset?
target: Sessions with SpecialDay greater than zero have an observed conversion rate of 5.8% across 121 sessions. Sessions with SpecialDay equal to zero convert at 16.5% across 1,112 sessions. This comparison is associative and does not isolate the effect of a special day from other factors.
